voice.name: Open Sector - Titan
voice.description: Towering, calm, commanding male walker pilot in his forties, deep resonant baritone with slow steady cadence, authoritative like a battleship captain, never raises his voice, quiet confidence and gravity, with a subtle metallic cockpit radio quality.
voice.sample: Titan, standing tall. My gun reaches far and my rockets reach farther. Rivers do not stop me, walls do not stop me. Give the order, and I will anchor here and hold this ground until nothing is left standing.

select: I see everything from up here.

fire.prompt: Heavy 75mm cannon fired from a large war machine, deep boom with sharp crack and echo, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice

rockets.prompt: Ripple salvo of four rockets launching one after another in quick succession, whooshing roar of rocket motors streaking away, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Giant heavy walking war machine taking two enormous ground-shaking footsteps, deep metallic thuds with hydraulic hiss and servo groan, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Giant walking war machine destroyed, huge explosion with tearing metal and massive steel frame crashing to the ground, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Heavy hydraulic stabilizer legs extending and slamming down into the ground, loud metal clunks and hydraulic hiss, anchoring lock clank, close, no music, no voice
